visual_action: A slideshow of still photos from a large political convention. The first shot is a wide view of the stage and a massive crowd, with a large screen showing Barack Obama waving. The next shot shows enthusiastic supporters in the crowd, with one woman holding a sign reading "NOW" with the Obama campaign logo. The third shot shows Michelle Obama on stage holding the hands of her two young daughters. The final shot is of the large screen again, this time showing Barack and Michelle Obama embracing and laughing, with American flags on either side.
